summary: DENSE_RANK assigns equal ranks to peers and advances by one for the next distinct ordering value.
syntax: DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY group_column ORDER BY score DESC)
documentation: DENSE_RANK assigns equal ranks to peers and advances by one for the next distinct ordering value. Unlike ROW_NUMBER it keeps ties together, and unlike RANK it leaves no gaps after a tie.
returns: A rank beginning at 1 in each partition.
caution: Adding a unique ID to the window ordering would break score ties. Use a separate final ordering to display tied rows deterministically.
scenarios: Rank branch sales scores while keeping tied teams together.
Assign contiguous performance tiers to equal measurements.
Compare contest standings separately within each regional group.
title: Rank branch results with ties
problem: From results(id INTEGER, branch TEXT, score INTEGER), return id, branch and dense_rank() over each branch ordered by score descending as place. Equal scores share a place, with no skipped places. Display by branch, score descending, id ascending. All fields are non-NULL; id is unique.
goal: Use DENSE_RANK() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Partition by branch and rank by score only; include id only in the final ORDER BY.
